text: This is one particular phone - a Xiaomi POCO X3 NFC, known by its codename surya - kept on a desk and plugged into a lab machine, so that making Linux work on it can be done carefully, the same way each time, and without ever leaving it broken.

heading: A phone is easy to strand
text: Work on a phone's deepest parts and one wrong step leaves it dark, with nobody near to press its buttons. So people work cautiously and slowly, keep their fixes in their heads, and lose them at the next clean start.

heading: Everything about this phone, written down
text:
The lab holds what is true of this phone and nothing else: how to reach it, what to bake into every fresh start, which checks it must pass, which tones a microphone should hear from it. The tools are the same for any phone; this is the one sheet that makes them fit this one.

Every experiment is a single try that falls back by itself. The phone always returns to a state known to work.

heading: A patient's chart at the end of the bed
text: Whoever comes next - a person or an agent - reads the chart and knows what was done, what holds, and what must not be touched without care.

heading: What it has not reached
text: Its microphone does not work yet, and no call has been made on it. Its cameras, its fingerprint reader and its NFC have not been tried.

heading: Where it stands
text: It can be flashed to a known state by one command. Twenty-two checks pass after every start. Sound plays from both speakers; a machine hearing it reliably still waits for a microphone fixed in place.
